# Keybindings

> Every default keyboard shortcut the *Sonic Pi for VS Code* extension contributes, with the command it runs and when it is active, generated from `package.json` `contributes.keybindings`.

| Key | macOS | Command | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `f5` | `f5` | Sonic Pi: Run (`sonicpi.run`) | `editorLangId == sonicpi` |
| `shift+f5` | `shift+f5` | Sonic Pi: Stop (`sonicpi.stop`) | `editorLangId == sonicpi` |
| `ctrl+f5` | `cmd+f5` | Sonic Pi: Run Selection (`sonicpi.runSelection`) | `editorLangId == sonicpi` |
